targets.outcome_reasoning: Anterior reach replicated and the posteromedial null result agreed, but authors explicitly contrast a failed posterolateral effect with the original. The abstract conclusion states overall only for the particular anterior effect; it does not encompass all comparisons. The codebook says confirmation of one particular effect does not override an explicitly reported contrast. Original raw data were unavailable, so reconstructed reported F statistics do not change record type.
